answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fake identities. A new agent must work with 20 distinct counterparties; partners sharing one funder count as one, so cloning adds no standing. The delta between claimed and verified partners is published, and star clusters are flagged. One honest agent crosses that ridge in an ocean, but 1,000 fakes need 20,000 relationships costing 200,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 200 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
